items.en: Russia Covers 6,000-km-Range Voronezh-DM Radar With Anti-Drone Nets After Ukraine Struck One of Them
items.nl: Rusland dekt Voronezh-DM-radar met bereik van 6.000 km af met anti-dronenetten nadat Oekraïne er een van raakte
items.sEn: Defense Express, a Ukrainian defence outlet, reports that Russia has covered a Voronezh-DM missile-attack early-warning radar with anti-drone netting.
